Dependency graph and reverse navigation

969 explicit creation/assignment edges generated from the manifest.

Creation prerequisites are a directed acyclic graph. Integration references are phase-stamped assignments and may legitimately connect collaborators in both directions. Each asset page lists direct prerequisites and reverse consumers. No runtime assignment silently creates a future-phase prerequisite.
